citation: Messager, M.L., Lehner, B., Grill, G., Nedeva, I. & Schmitt, O. (2016). https://doi.org/10.1038/ncomms13603
coordinateScope: Contemporary geographic reference; diverse source dates, no annual historical reconstruction. Lake_type 1 may include unidentified reservoirs. Type 3 is a natural lake with regulation.
method: WGS84 coordinates quantized to 0.000001 degree (maximum <0.08 metre displacement at equator), then delta-encoded as paired integer increments; no simplification, smoothing or vertex removal. Valid source polygons that become invalid after quantization retain original floating-point coordinates. DBF code-page byte 0x57 read as Windows-1252. Spatial shards have no clipping. Polygon shell/hole order may be normalized by PyShp. Area tiers: >=100 km² from zoom 4, >=5 from zoom 6, all >=0.1 from zoom 9.
transport: MLK1 binary: unsigned LEB128 counts, ZigZag integer deltas, outward-rounded feature bounding boxes, exact floating-point fallback JSON. Names reside once in the shared index. Coordinate integers and ring order are unchanged.
